body:
## Why

`issue-graph` currently traces GitHub issues and pull requests, but teams may track related work in Jira. This adds a read-only Jira workflow using the customer-facing Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI (`twg`) while preserving the existing GitHub behavior.

## What changed

- Add `issue-graph jira ISSUE-KEY` for Jira relationship discovery through TWG.
- Add `crawlGraph`, a source-neutral bounded graph traversal API.
- Preserve minimum-depth BFS ordering when source policies jump directly to a depth boundary.
- Support explicit Atlassian site selection with `--site`.
- Emit Markdown in terminals and versioned JSON in pipes.
- Add the Node-only `issue-graph/transport/twg` package export.
- Document Jira setup, permissions, coverage, privacy, library usage, and agent workflows.

## Traversal behavior

- Same-project references recurse to `--depth`.
- Structured cross-project issue links and remote links are fetched as one-hop boundaries.
- Cross-project keys found only in free text are reported but not fetched.
  - This prevents ordinary tokens such as `UTF-8`, `SHA-1`, `ISO-8601`, and `RFC-2119` from causing failed Jira reads.
- Pending nodes are processed by minimum known depth.
  - Nearer work takes priority under `--max-nodes`.
  - A later shorter path lowers a pending node before it is fetched.
- Non-Jira remote links are reported but not fetched.
- Failed reads and capped nodes remain explicit coverage evidence.

## TWG compatibility

The transport supports customer TWG builds that either:

- return raw JSON with summary output disabled, or
- reject that option and provide JSON through a `stats` summary file.

Summary files are read and removed immediately.

## Safety and privacy

- Read-only: does not create, edit, transition, or comment on Jira work items.
- Does not install TWG or read/store Atlassian tokens.
- Jira mode creates no issue-graph snapshots.
- Inaccessible work items remain explicit failed nodes rather than being treated as absent.
- Markdown output escapes untrusted Jira values.
- Link destinations are parsed, restricted to HTTP(S), normalized, and safely rendered.
- Live validation used private input only; no customer identifiers or Jira content are retained in this change.

## Verification

- `pnpm check` — 635 tests passed, plus lint, typecheck, and build
- `pnpm test:docs` / `pnpm check:docs` — 96 tests passed
- `pnpm test:package` under Node 24 — 48 package smoke commands passed
- `pnpm build:docs` — production documentation build passed
- Read-only live smoke validation passed with a one-node/depth-zero boundary
- All commits are SSH-signed and shown as Verified by GitHub

## Review focus

1. `crawlGraph` minimum-depth admission and node-cap behavior
2. Jira normalization and confidence-aware edge traversal
3. TWG output compatibility and temporary-file cleanup
4. Markdown and URL safety boundaries
title: feat(jira): add read-only issue graphs through TWG
